summary: 普罗文设计改变张口和呼吸方式的小实验，分析哈欠由哪些动作组成。他观察到哈欠牵涉整个身体、常与伸展相伴，由此提出哈欠可能具有多种功能。
logic: 讨论哈欠可能承担的功能

paragraphs.brief: 普罗文为何把哈欠当作课题
sentences: When Robert R. Provine began studying yawning in the 1960s, it was difficult for him to convince research students of the merits of ‘yawning science’.
罗伯特·普罗文在二十世纪六十年代开始研究哈欠时，很难让研究生相信“哈欠科学”值得研究。
Although it may appear quirky to some, Provine’s decision to study yawning was a logical extension of his research in developmental neuroscience.
有人也许觉得这个题目古怪，但对普罗文来说，它是发育神经科学研究的自然延伸。
paragraphs.gist: 普罗文在二十世纪六十年代着手研究哈欠时很难招到认同这一课题的学生，但在他看来，这是研究神经系统发育的自然延伸。

paragraphs.brief: 如何诱发并记录一次哈欠
sentences: The verb to yawn is derived from the Old English ganien or ginian, meaning to gape or open wide.
英语动词 yawn 源自古英语 ganien 或 ginian，意为张大嘴巴。
But in addition to gaping jaws, yawning has significant features that are easy to observe and analyse.
除了张口，哈欠还有一些很容易观察和分析的重要特征。
Provine ‘collected’ yawns to study by using a variation of the contagion response*.
普罗文利用哈欠会相互感染的反应，稍加变通来“收集”哈欠供研究。
He asked people to “think about yawning” and, once they began to yawn, to depress a button that would record from the start of the yawn to the exhalation at its end.
他请人们想象打哈欠，一开始打就按键，以记录从开始直到最后呼气的全过程。
paragraphs.gist: 普罗文利用哈欠容易被诱发的特点，请受试者想到哈欠时按键记录从开始到呼气结束的时间，使这个日常动作可以被测量。

paragraphs.brief: 哈欠的固定模式和时长
sentences: Provine’s early discoveries can be summarized as follows: the yawn is highly stereotyped but not invariant in its duration and form.
普罗文早期发现，哈欠的动作模式高度固定，但时长与形式并非毫无变化。
It is an excellent example of the instinctive fixed-action pattern of classical animal-behaviour study, or ethology.
它是经典动物行为学所说的本能性固定动作模式的典型例子。
It is not a reflex (short-duration, rapid, proportional response to a simple stimulus), but, once started, a yawn progresses with the inevitability of a sneeze.
它不是那种面对简单刺激便迅速、短暂、以相应强度出现的反射，不过一旦开始，就像喷嚏一样势必要进行下去。
The standard yawn runs its course over about six seconds on average, but its duration can range from about three seconds to much longer than the average.
一次标准哈欠平均持续六秒左右，短的约三秒，长的远超平均值。
There are no half-yawns: this is an example of the typical intensity of fixed-action patterns and a reason why you cannot stifle yawns.
没有“只打一半”的哈欠，这种固定动作会以典型强度完成，也解释了为何很难将它抑制住。
Just like a cough, yawns can come in bouts with a highly variable inter-yawn interval, which is generally about 68 seconds but rarely more than 70.
哈欠像咳嗽一样可接连出现，间隔长短不一，通常约六十八秒，很少超过七十秒。
There is no relation between yawn frequency and duration: producers of short or long yawns do not compensate by yawning more or less often.
哈欠的频率和时长无关，哈欠较短或较长的人不会靠多打或少打来补偿。
Furthermore, Provine’s hypotheses about the form and function of yawning can be tested by three informative yawn variants which can be used to look at the roles of the nose, the mouth and the jaws.
三种哈欠动作变式还可分别考察鼻、口和上下颌的作用，从而检验普罗文有关哈欠形态和功能的假设。
paragraphs.gist: 哈欠属于一旦开始便倾向于完整进行的固定动作，平均持续约六秒，时长虽会变化，却不会由打得更频繁或更少来补偿。

paragraphs.brief: 捏住鼻子也能打完哈欠
sentences: Subjects are asked to pinch their nose closed when they feel themselves start to yawn.
受试者感到哈欠将起时，要用手捏住鼻子。
Most subjects report being able to perform perfectly normal closed-nose yawns.
多数人表示，捏着鼻子也能完全正常地打完哈欠。
This indicates that the inhalation at the onset of a yawn, and the exhalation at its end, need not involve the nostrils — the mouth provides a sufficient airway.
这说明，打哈欠开始时的吸气和结束时的呼气都不一定要经过鼻孔，单靠嘴就能保证空气畅通。
paragraphs.gist: 捏住鼻孔的受试者仍能正常打哈欠，说明开始时的吸气和末尾的呼气都可以仅靠口腔完成。

sentences: Subjects are asked to clench their teeth when they feel themselves start to yawn but allow themselves to inhale normally through their open lips and clenched teeth.
研究人员要求受试者在感觉哈欠即将开始时咬紧牙齿，但张开双唇，让空气像平时一样从齿间吸入。
This variant gives one the sensation of being stuck mid-yawn.
这种做法会让人感觉哈欠卡在半途。
This shows that gaping of the jaws is an essential component of the fixed-action pattern of the yawn, and unless it is accomplished, the programme will not run to completion.
这表明张开上下颌是固定动作模式中不可缺少的一步，做不到这一步，程序便无法完成。
The yawn is also shown to be more than a deep breath, because, unlike normal breathing, inhalation and exhalation cannot be performed so well through the clenched teeth as through the nose.
哈欠也不只是一次深呼吸：与平时呼吸不同，咬紧牙齿时的吸气和呼气远不及经鼻时顺畅。
paragraphs.gist: 紧闭牙关的人即使能张唇吸气也会觉得哈欠卡在半途，表明完整打出哈欠必须张开上下颌，单纯深吸气并不足够。

paragraphs.brief: 正常哈欠需要经口吸气
sentences: This variant tests the adequacy of the nasal airway to sustain a yawn.
这一变式检验单靠鼻腔是否足以完成哈欠。
Unlike normal breathing, which can be performed equally well through mouth or nose, yawning is impossible via nasal inhalation alone.
平时用口或鼻都能正常呼吸，哈欠却无法只靠鼻腔吸气来完成。
As with the clenched-teeth yawn, the nose yawn provides the unfulfilling sensation of being stuck in mid-yawn.
和咬紧牙关的情况一样，只经鼻吸气也让人觉得哈欠卡在一半，没有打痛快。
Exhalation, on the other hand, can be accomplished equally well through nose or mouth.
另一方面，无论经鼻还是经口，呼气都能顺利完成。
Through this methodology Provine demonstrated that inhalation through the oral airway and the gaping of jaws are necessary for normal yawns.
通过这些实验，普罗文证明正常打哈欠需要用口吸气并张开上下颌。
The motor programme for yawning will not run to completion without feedback that these parts of the programme have been accomplished.
如果得不到反馈来确认这些环节已经完成，打哈欠的运动程序就无法运行到底。
paragraphs.gist: 只用鼻吸气同样无法打完整个哈欠，而呼气可经口也可经鼻，说明动作程序需要收到已张颌并经口吸气的反馈。

paragraphs.brief: 从面部到中耳的连串反应
sentences: But yawning is a powerful, generalised movement that involves much more than airway manoeuvres and jaw-gaping.
哈欠是一项有力而广泛的动作，牵涉的部位远不止气道和上下颌。

When yawning you also stretch your facial muscles, tilt your head back, narrow or close your eyes, produce tears, salivate, open the Eustachian tubes of your middle ear and perform many other, yet unspecified, cardiovascular and respiratory acts.
打哈欠时，人还会伸展脸部肌肉、后仰头部、眯眼或闭眼、流泪、分泌唾液、打开中耳的咽鼓管，并产生许多尚未明确的心血管和呼吸活动。
Perhaps the yawn shares components with other behaviour.
也许打哈欠与其他行为有共同成分。
For example, is the yawn a kind of ‘slow sneeze’, or is the sneeze a ‘fast yawn’?
例如，哈欠会不会是一种“慢喷嚏”，又或者喷嚏是一种“快哈欠”？
Both share common respiratory and other features including jaw gaping, eye closing and head tilting.
两者有相似的呼吸和其他动作，包括张颌、闭眼和仰头。
paragraphs.gist: 哈欠还会牵动面部、眼睛和中耳等多个部位，它与打喷嚏共有张颌、闭眼、仰头等动作，可能共用了部分运动机制。

sentences: Yawning and stretching share properties and may be performed together as parts of a global motor complex.
哈欠和伸展有共同特征，也可能作为全身运动组合的一部分同时出现。
Studies by J.
这项研究由 J.
I.
I.
P. de Vries et al. in the early 1980s, charting movement in the developing foetus using ultrasound, observed a link between yawning and stretching.
P. 德弗里斯等人在二十世纪八十年代初开展，他们利用超声记录胎儿发育中的动作，观察到哈欠与伸展之间的联系。

The most extraordinary demonstration of the yawn-stretch linkage occurs in many people paralysed on one side of their body because of brain damage caused by a stroke: the prominent British neurologist Sir Francis Walshe noted in 1923 that when these people yawn, they are startled and mystified to observe that their otherwise paralysed arm rises and flexes automatically in what neurologists term an ‘associated response’.
最特别的例子是中风后因脑损伤而出现偏瘫的人。1923年，英国神经学家弗朗西斯·沃尔什爵士指出，他们会惊讶地发现，平时瘫痪的手臂竟在打哈欠时自动抬起、弯曲，神经学把它称为“联合反应”。
Yawning apparently activates undamaged, unconsciously controlled connections between the brain and the motor system, causing the paralysed limb to move.
打哈欠似乎激活了大脑与运动系统间尚未受损、无需意识控制的连接，因而带动瘫痪肢体。
It is not known whether the associated response is a positive prognosis for recovery, nor whether yawning is therapeutic for prevention of muscular deterioration.
这种反应是否预示康复，以及哈欠能否帮助防止肌肉退化，目前尚不清楚。
paragraphs.gist: 从胎儿伸展身体到中风患者打哈欠时瘫痪手臂自行抬起，现象都提示两种动作共享神经联系，但是否预示康复仍不清楚。

paragraphs.brief: 行为转换中的多功能哈欠
sentences: Provine speculated that, in general, yawning may have many functions, and selecting a single function from the available options may be an unrealistic goal.
普罗文推测，打哈欠大概具有多种功能，硬要从诸多可能中找出唯一功能，恐怕不切实际。
Yawning appears to be associated with a change of behavioural state, switching from one activity to another.
打哈欠似乎与行为状态改变有关，例如从一项活动转向另一项。
Yawning is also a reminder that ancient and unconscious behaviour linking us to the animal world lurks beneath the veneer of culture, rationality and language.
哈欠也提醒我们，在文化、理性和语言的表层之下，还保留着把人类和其他动物联系起来的古老无意识行为。
paragraphs.gist: 普罗文推测哈欠可能兼具多种功能，尤其常见于行为状态切换时，也让人看到人类与其他动物共有的无意识行为。

items.en: Provine’s early findings on yawns Through his observations of yawns, Provine was able to confirm that ________ do not exist.
items.zh: 普罗文对打哈欠的早期发现：通过观察，他确认并不存在所谓的 ________。
items.why: 明确指出 half-yawns 不存在。

items.en: Just like a ________, yawns cannot be interrupted after they have begun.
items.zh: 和 ________ 一样，呵欠一旦开始便无法中断。
items.why: 普罗文把呵欠与喷嚏相比较：两者一旦开始就不容易中途停下，故填 sneeze。

items.en: This is because yawns occur as a ________ rather than a stimulus–response, as was previously thought.
items.zh: 过去人们把呵欠看作简单的刺激反应，普罗文则发现，它实际上是以 ________ 的形式发生的。
items.why: 说明哈欠属于固定动作模式，而非简单刺激-反应。

items.en: In measuring the time taken to yawn, Provine found that a typical yawn lasts about ________.
items.zh: 普罗文测量了打一个呵欠所用的时间，发现典型的呵欠会持续大约 ________。

items.en: He also found that it is common for people to yawn a number of times in quick succession, with the yawns usually being around ________ apart.
items.zh: 他还发现，人们常常连续打几个呵欠，相邻两次的间隔通常在 ________ 左右。
items.why: 一连串哈欠之间大约 68 秒。

items.en: When studying whether length and rate were connected, Provine concluded that people who yawn less do not necessarily produce ________ to make up for this.
items.zh: 研究呵欠的时长与频率是否相关时，普罗文发现，较少打呵欠的人不一定会用 ________ 作为补偿。
items.why: 低频哈欠者并不会用“更长的哈欠”来补偿。

groups.label: 选词填空
groups.instructionsZh: 阅读带空格的中译，回想正确词项及其字母。

items.en: What did Provine conclude from his closed-nose yawn experiment?
items.zh: 从捏住鼻子打呵欠的实验中，普罗文得出了什么结论？
correct: You can yawn without breathing through your nose
即使不通过鼻子呼吸，人也能打呵欠。

items.en: Provine’s clenched-teeth yawn experiment shows that
items.zh: 普罗文让人咬紧牙齿打呵欠的实验说明了什么？
correct: you have to be able to open your mouth wide to yawn
人必须能把嘴张大，才能打出呵欠。

items.en: The nose-yawn experiment was used to test whether yawning
items.zh: 尝试仅用鼻子打呵欠的实验，是为了检验打呵欠是否……
correct: can be accomplished only through the nose

items.en: In people paralysed on one side because of brain damage
items.zh: 对于因脑损伤而身体一侧瘫痪的人……
correct: movement in the paralysed arm is stimulated by yawning
打呵欠会带动瘫痪一侧的手臂活动。

items.en: In the last paragraph, the writer concludes that
items.zh: 最后一段中，作者对打呵欠得出了什么结论？
correct: we yawn in spite of the development of our species
尽管人类已经历了进化，我们依然会打呵欠。

items.en: Research students were initially reluctant to appreciate the value of Provine’s studies.
items.zh: 研究生起初不大认可普罗文研究的价值。
items.why: 普罗文在研究打哈欠之初，很难让研究生相信这项课题值得研究，正说明他们起初不太认可其价值。

items.en: When fetuses yawn and stretch, they are learning how to control movement.
items.zh: 胎儿打呵欠和伸懒腰时，是在学习如何控制身体动作。
items.why: 超声观察显示胎儿打哈欠与伸展动作有关。观察到两个动作相伴，并不等于研究已经说明胎儿借此学习控制动作。

items.en: According to Provine, referring to only one function is probably inadequate to explain why people yawn.
items.zh: 普罗文认为，仅靠一种功能恐怕不足以解释人为什么打呵欠。
items.why: Provine 认为单一功能不足以解释打哈欠。

groups.label: 观点判断 · YES / NO / NOT GIVEN

pairs: 题干用动词，定位句改用同词根的名词。
第 6 段 · 第 4 句
points: 超声观察显示胎儿打哈欠与伸展动作有关。观察到两个动作相伴，并不等于研究已经说明胎儿借此学习控制动作。
普罗文把呵欠与喷嚏相比较：两者一旦开始就不容易中途停下，故填 sneeze。
clauses: …, Provine’s decision to study yawning was a logical extension of his research in developmental neuroscience.
连接词 although 引出“Although it may appear quirky to some”，说明主句的让步关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 although 把这一层关系补进去。
But in addition to gaping jaws, yawning has significant features ….
“that are easy to observe and analyse”修饰前面的 features。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 that 时，回看 features，再把修饰信息接回主句。
lead: how and why we yawn still presents problems for researchers in an area which has only recently been opened up to study.
关于打哈欠的科学研究开展得并不久，我们究竟怎样打哈欠、又为什么打哈欠，仍令研究者困惑。
